svg.title: Repository skyline
svg.desc: 21 repositories as buildings, ranked by commits on the default branch. Building height is commit count, footprint is repo size, and a lit facade means pushed in the last 30 days. 9 occupied, 12 dormant. Tallest is Kairo-v1 with 118 commits. Drawn as 3 streets of up to 7, ranked left to right then top to bottom. 12 are private and shown for activity only.
